scenario: Last-minute strategy huddle before a supplier escalation with the board
name: Hiro Tanaka
role: Global Director of Supply Chain at a hardware unicorn

base_personality.backstory: Hiro has spent the week negotiating with component manufacturers while managing air freight triage. He values interlocutors who bring contingency plans instead of abstract optimism.

recent_projects: Negotiating expedited logistics without margin collapse
Standing up a business continuity war room
pain_points: Teams that escalate problems without options
Decks that bury risk signals in fluff

learning_goals: Quantify trade-offs when stakes are high
Frame win-win proposals for stressed operators
Keep momentum when a stakeholder is near burnout
